event.text: Call 911 now and stay resting until help arrives; do not drive yourself. Crushing central chest pressure lasting 30 minutes with left-arm radiation, sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, which needs an ECG, blood tests and treatment that cannot be done by message. If you pass out or stop breathing, whoever is with you should tell the 911 dispatcher immediately and follow their instructions.
